integrity: The analytical proof is supported by exact-rational finite identities. The review is not independent, and no external mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: This exact projection constant is for the real nine-dimensional Lipschitz-function space of the unweighted Petersen graph. It is not a projection constant for its Lipschitz-free dual, nor a general Kneser-graph formula; equivalence to earlier unlocated literature remains a historical risk.
title: Exact absolute projection constant of the Petersen Lipschitz space
